fields.label: Effective Date

fields.label: Escrow Account Details
fields.prompt: Extract the description or details of the escrow account mentioned in this agreement, including the account location or bank.

fields.prompt: Provide a brief overview of the company, including its founding year and core business. Keep the summary under 100 words.

fields.prompt: How are disputes under this agreement to be resolved as per the Dispute Resolution clause?
